name: Three concentric arc rails about the GH centre (no hubs)
verdict: dead - not worth a GPU sweep: bigger rails are always worse (the hub limit wins, i.e. the 3R it came from); converged best 73.0 does not beat the baseline 68.93 and parks the J2 rail 17 cm out (inband14 0.19)
limiter: J2 rail radius: per-pose need median 62 mm but p95 121 / max 183 mm at 90-150 deg abduction (plane 0-30), where the J2 axis points ~26 deg from the humerus and the rail lands on the arm; spec great circles / C-ring have no finite radius (run through trunk/neck)
note: best = PARAMS (sweep k438/k441, radius fit iterated to a fixed point, p98): crowns rho 12/20/12 about the champion axes with base az -30; R1 62, R2 171, R3 75 mm. Unconverged 2-pass entries (k369 57.3) and rev-1/2a entries are superseded; spec passive slide not needed on the bench (GH fixed); AUDIT 2026-10-15T19:12:07Z: reproduced exactly on Bench(60,160) fast (gap 73.0, R2 170.9); no modelling bug, convention or range error found; 3 hub-limit / 3 phi2 probes all worse (best 81.3). Dead stands: it degenerates to the hub 3R and only u_az differs.

mechanism.notes: spherical 3R with every joint a carriage on an arc rail about GH. bodies: carriage 1 + link 1 + rail 2 (one rigid body), carriage 2 + link 2 + C-ring carriage, arm-end (C-ring fixed to the cuff). joints: 3 carriage / rail track pairs (V-wheels). The spec's passive cuff slide is not modelled (GH fixed on the bench: 'not needed'); keeping it would add 1 passive_trans, 1 body, 1 joint, 1 track pair. custom: rail 1, carriage 1, link 1, rail 2, carriage 2, link 2, ring carriage, C-ring, 12 V-wheel pins (est.); catalogue: 12 MR83-class V-wheels (est.).
